mods.name: Legacy LWJGL3 dependency shim for Pylon
mods.description: Satisfies legacy-lwjgl3 metadata dependencies while Pylon provides the LWJGL compatibility layer.

releases.notes:
Compatibility shim that supplies the `legacy-lwjgl3` mod id and the optional `PreeditAwareWidget` API for [Pylon](https://github.com/notdevcody/pylon) (the renamed continuation of Lenis) on Ornithe 1.8.9.

### Changes
- Require `pylon` instead of `lenis`
- IME focus callback stays a no-op: Pylon owns the SDL text-input path.

mods.name: Legacy LWJGL3 dependency shim for Lenis
mods.description: Satisfies legacy-lwjgl3 metadata dependencies while Lenis provides the LWJGL compatibility layer.

releases.notes:
Initial release of the Lenis dependency shim.

The artifact satisfies the legacy-lwjgl3 dependency and provides the optional PreeditAwareWidget API expected by AxolotlClient. It accepts any Lenis version.

readmeSummary: This is the small compatibility shim used with Pylon on Ornithe 1.8.9.
